title: Arthur Taylor's car wreck in New Jersey and Coltrane's rescue
summary: Arthur Taylor crashes his new car after a New Jersey gig and Coltrane leaves the Cafe Bohemia stand to drive them home.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: boy, you get lost quick. You be two or three bars behind you see, and this stuff be going on you know, and I'm scuffing it man, trying to be playing over here in New Jersey someplace, so I'm scuffing it and this music's so Arthur Taylor bought a brand new automobile, he couldn't drive a lick, no lick, no license, so he took this car, somebody drove it over there to New Jersey.

Where we was working at $ I didn't know that so he tell me, he say, "Sam, you and Rouse, you know, ride back with me, man, you know, so drive on back, and his eyes weren't all that good, I don't know, he couldn't see good either, so big intersection, man like they had uh, I forgot what part of Jersey this is over here, but there's a big intersection man, they have all kinds of light up there.
Red, enamel, all kinds of lights, for to tell you to stop, but you come to this great big intersection and there was a bridge, too, there was a bridge, around the corner.
He drove straight out in the middle of that intersection, man, and a car came down off that bridge doing about 60 miles an hour and hit us, man.
Spin us and it was raining too...

...and man, I got myself together, you know, and I got out, jumped out of the car and he telling me, said "man what should I do, should I run? I said "run! Run where? What'cha gonna run from man?" I said "this is your car ain't it? What you gonna run from?" He said, "Oh, man!" So finally the police came. Police come, and they were nice man, the state troopers.

Man, they was some nice guys man, and uh, uh, they said, we was standing out there in the rain man, so he had, A.T., had told the man he had left his license home, you know, and so, so they took us down to the station, and said man, "we take you over to the station, wasn't far from there."
"And so you guys can get some hot coffee," and gave us some hot coffee and doughnuts.
Coltrane was working over at the Cafe Bohemia.
So, we called Coltrane up....remember that Plymouth he had?
Trane was on the bandstand playing man, and we told him, 'man we were involved in a wreck over here and uh, and uh come over there and get us'.
He got right off the stage, got in his car, and came over there and picked us up, all the way in New Jersey, man, I'll never forget that man.
And brought, took me home, brought me home, took Arthur home, took Rouse home.
